tips.title: Iron-friendly lunch
tips.body: Build a plate with lentils or leafy greens plus something vitamin-C rich (citrus, peppers). Pair with a carb you enjoy so it actually gets eaten.

tips.title: Heat + 10 quiet minutes
tips.body: Warm compress on your lower abdomen and a phone-free pause can take the edge off cramps better than pushing through.

tips.title: Easy stroll only
tips.body: If flow is heavy, skip intense sessions. A short flat walk or gentle stretch is enough movement today.

tips.title: Softer schedule
tips.body: Leave buffer between meetings and say no to one optional plan if energy is low.

tips.title: Warm comfort bowl
tips.body: Soup or warm oats often sit better than cold food when cramps are active.

tips.title: Earlier bedtime
tips.body: Pain can fragment sleep — start wind-down 30 minutes earlier tonight.

tips.title: Strength window
tips.body: This phase often feels best for lifting or a challenging class — keep form clean and stop with 1–2 reps in reserve.

tips.title: Protein breakfast
tips.body: Eggs, yogurt, tofu, or a protein smoothie within an hour of waking sets up steadier morning energy.

tips.title: Start one tiny habit
tips.body: Stack a 2-minute habit onto something you already do (after coffee, after brushing teeth).

tips.title: Still sleep well
tips.body: Rising energy isn’t a reason to cut sleep short — protect your bedtime like a meeting.

tips.title: Colorful produce x2
tips.body: Two different fruits or veggies today support micronutrients as training ramps up.

tips.title: Joy movement
tips.body: Add one session you love (dance, hike, class) so training doesn’t feel like punishment.

tips.title: Fertile-day awareness
tips.body: Timing estimates aren’t birth control. If you’re preventing pregnancy, be consistent with your method this window.

tips.title: Enjoy peak energy
tips.body: Channel today’s lift into movement you love — hard is fine if you feel strong and recovered.

tips.title: Don’t skip meals
tips.body: Busy social or date days still need real food; pair caffeine with a meal if you’re sensitive.

tips.title: Protect tomorrow
tips.body: High-energy nights add up — keep at least one early bedtime this week.

tips.title: Clarify your goal
tips.body: TTC, open, or preventing? A clear intention reduces anxiety during fertile days.

tips.title: Hydration bump
tips.body: More activity and social plans usually need more water — keep a bottle visible.

tips.title: Craving-smart snack
tips.body: Pair something sweet with protein or nuts so you stay satisfied longer and avoid the crash.

tips.title: Earlier wind-down
tips.body: Progesterone can disrupt sleep for some — dim screens and start bedtime earlier.

tips.title: Steady, not max
tips.body: Choose strength, yoga, or a brisk walk over all-out HIIT if you feel flat or bloated.

tips.title: Mood buffer
tips.body: Plan one low-stimulation hour for yourself before evening stress stacks.

tips.title: Warm dinner plate
tips.body: Soup, rice bowls, or roasted veggies often feel better than cold salads premenstrually.

tips.title: Deadline triage
tips.body: If PMS is rising, move one non-urgent hard conversation or deadline if you can.
